# proxmox_cluster_mapping_dir (Resource)

Manages a cluster-wide directory mapping through `/cluster/mapping/dir`, referenced by `virtiofs` directory ids.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_mapping_dir" "share" {
  id  = "shared-srv"
  map = [{ node = "pve-1", path = "/srv/share" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stable mapping identifier (`pve-configid`). Changes require replacement.
- `map` (Attributes Set) Node to directory mapping. Every entry needs `node` and an absolute `path`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Mapping description.

### Read-Only

- `live_migration_capable` (Boolean) Always null; only PCI mappings support live migration.

<a id="nestedatt--map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `map`

Required:

- `node` (String) Cluster node the map entry belongs to.
- `path` (String) Absolute directory path shared with the guest.
